proof_preparation.headline: A Round of Answers
proof_preparation.deck: A charity invitation. A familiar rival. Nothing casual about the round.
proof_preparation.body_copy: The invitation promised a morning for a good cause. The round exposed less charitable intentions. Duckhook knew every ridge of his own course; ObiWan had returned with a memory the host would rather forget. A clean strike earned a glance. A ball in the rough earned silence. By the time they walked toward the green, the autumn light was still beautiful. Neither man was looking at it.
